title: A processor without the operation is not retried as a passing fault; the batch shows a large read's real progress
found_by: docs/evidence/runtime/reh2/result.json needsCode[1]; report.md 'What a demo roll would hit' item 4

defects.signature: processor 404 for resolve-geojson-crs became 503 AREA_PROCESSING; the reader retried three whole re-reads (about 280 s for Niagara) and the row said only 'could not be read and interpreted completely'
defects.change: areaGeo turns a processor 404 or 405 (no route for the operation) into 503 AREA_PROCESSOR_OPERATION naming the operation; the reader's streamingFailureKind ends that code at once like a refused file (prefix kept, no retry); the row's sentence says the map processor must be updated
defects.http_status: unchanged at 503, so no route's published error list changes

defects.signature: the batch row showed 300 records and 3 parts for 284 s while the reader published 424 parts and 42247 records: the large step's state key holds no reader counts, so no step ran to rewrite the row until the reader's state changed
defects.change: the reader's slot transaction writes the row's stored reading counts (writeIntakeLargeReadTx: only in the read phase, never at rest, never a failure) at most once per 2 s; every other state stays the step's to write
defects.lock_order: the slot transaction holds the case and source FOR SHARE, then the import row, then the item row; the large step takes the case FOR UPDATE before the item row, so the two serialize

ingestion_and_areas_suites.failure_cause: no database and no E:/BhuAayam-data in the cloud container

not_done: No runtime rehearsal: no Docker or database here. The Niagara read with an old processor image is the runtime check for the lead.

The intake-large drafting step still retries a 503 AREA_PROCESSOR_OPERATION up to its attempt limit (outside the reader; not seen in REH2).
